stem.text: The diagram shows a stage micrometer scale viewed with an eyepiece graticule, using a magnification of $\times 200$.

stem.alt: Circular field of view showing a stage micrometer scale with numbered divisions from 0 to 100, a bracket labelled 0.1 mm spanning 40 divisions, and an eyepiece graticule scale above it.

stem.text: Using the same magnification, a chloroplast is measured as 4 eyepiece graticule divisions long.
